verdict.rationale: Temporal's core architecture guarantees workflows resume exactly where they left off after worker crashes or infrastructure outages, with automatic retries and state rebuilt by another process (temporal-docs-1, temporal-docs-28, temporal-docs-40). Community users independently confirm workflows are durable and resumable across machines via deterministic replay (temporal-comm-1, temporal-comm-2), and Schedules/long-running support enables multi-day waits (temporal-docs-15, temporal-docs-25). Missing for 10: independent long-duration (multi-day) benchmark evidence, and one community report flags an edge case where slow worker heartbeats cause a workflow to stall 'In Progress' without automatic reschedule (temporal-comm-4), plus reported gaps in error visibility (temporal-comm-3).
